conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with an expected ~1.5%/month return, focusing on low drawdown. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, favoring broad index and quality names. Risk is lower, but so is potential upside.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for risk-first growth, targeting ~2.5%/month, by reducing overall leverage and concentration. It blends broad index exposure with quality tech and new high-potential setups. Expect moderate drawdowns with growth potential.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth, aiming for ~4%/month, by leaning into leveraged ETFs and high-scoring setups. This approach significantly amplifies both potential upside and drawdown. Be aware of daily decay in leveraged ETFs and the potential for rapid losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.

income.read: This income plan aims to park cash for yield, targeting ~1%/month through steady distributions. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income by rotating into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index funds. While distributions are variable and NAV can still fall, this strategy focuses on cash-like income over growth.
